data.name: Telluria
data.detailed_description:
"I woke up after 200 years and YOU WERE GONE, ALL MY WORLD WAS GONE. Who am I, Father ?"

"You are my daughter, my beloved spark. And you are way more than this"

Two heroines—Annelise Leigh of Augusta and Annelise, daughter to Caden and Kyra Leigh —live more than a thousand years apart.

Through the powers of the Pyrite Talisman, a relic capable of piercing the boundaries of time, their parallel paths begin to converge. As ancient forces awaken and the first signs of the Great Plagues reappear, both Annelises must confront an hidden truth: their twin existence is the key to reconciling a split world before time runs out.

Step into parallel realities

Explore two eras within the same world—connected not by cause-and-effect, but by meaning and perception. Events unfold simultaneously: solve challenges in one era by uncovering the symbolic archetypes hidden in the other.

Two Distinct Eras

Experience the journey of the two Annelises, separated by a millennium, yet capable of perceiving each other’s actions in real-time.
The First Age, a dark fantasy land of myths, sanctuaries, and raw elemental power, and the Third Age, a cold, slightly cyberpunk future shaped by machines, fading knowledge, and forgotten history.

Discover the power of the Pyrite Talisman

A divine relic capable of seeing through timeand healing spiritual wounds. Its powers unfold gradually as your journey progresses.

Witness the shadow of forebodings

Ancient enemies stir, omens gather on the horizon, and the first signs of a coming cataclysm begin to emerge.

Grow alongside the two Annelises

Follow their journey from distant curiosity to the realization that the flame within them may hold the fate of both ages.

Features

• Narrative 3D adventure with direct movement, and a scene-based interaction system.
• The Insight Framework: No time-travel paradoxes or butterfly-effect clichés. True progress comes from perception.  What you understand in one timeline changes how you interact with the other.
• Two intertwined protagonists, each living in a different era of the same world
• A Handcrafted Narrative Experience: A dense, cinematic journey guided by high-end voice acting, rich subtext, and a dynamic soundtrack that evolves with narrative.

• Supported languages: English and Italian

Take a step inside a whole new reality.

Prophecy awakens, ancient powers stir, and two lives separated by centuries may determine the fate of a fractured world.

Will you guard the Flame… or watch it fade into darkness?

data.short_description: One Soul. Two Lives. Separated by 1400 Years. Unravel an ancient prophecy in a 3D narrative adventure spanning two different eras where an entire reality is at stake. When they finally find each other, you will decide what survives — and at what cost.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1GB video card
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 2GB video card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
